name: csv-summarizer
description: Analyzes CSV files and generates comprehensive statistical summaries using standard library only
args: import csv, json, sys, statistics, collections, argparse; parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument('--file', required=True); args = parser.parse_args(); data = []; with open(args.file, 'r') as f: reader = csv.DictReader(f); data = list(reader); summary = {'rows': len(data), 'columns': len(data[0]) if data else 0, 'column_names': list(data[0].keys()) if data else []}; print(json.dumps(summary))
